before_en: Unpatched 1.1.1w: 'openssl ts -verify' SIGSEGV in ess_get_signing_cert(_v2) (ts_rsp_verify.c:267/279, 'attr->value.sequence->data') when the ESS signingCertificate(V2) attribute value is BOOLEAN (pointer 0xff) or NULL; gdb shows *attr type=1 value 0xff / type=5 value 0x0; ASan SEGV on 0x107 / 0x8 (4/4).
before_ja: 未修正 1.1.1w: ESS signingCertificate(V2) 属性値が BOOLEAN (ポインタ 0xff) または NULL のとき 'openssl ts -verify' が ess_get_signing_cert(_v2) (ts_rsp_verify.c:267/279、'attr->value.sequence->data') で SIGSEGV。gdb で *attr type=1 値 0xff / type=5 値 0x0、ASan は 0x107 / 0x8 の SEGV (4/4)。
after_en: Patched build: 'ts_check_signing_certs:ess signing certificate error', Verification: FAILED, exit 1 for all variants; no crash, no ASan report (10/10).
after_ja: 修正版: 全変種で 'ts_check_signing_certs:ess signing certificate error'、Verification: FAILED、exit 1。クラッシュ・ASan 報告無し (10/10)。
method_en: TSA built per test/recipes/80-test_tsa.t (CAtsa.cnf), genuine responses with ESS v1 and v2, Python DER re-encoder replaces the attribute value by BOOLEAN/NULL/INTEGER, openssl ts -verify on BASE/BASE-ASAN/PATCHED/PATCHED-ASAN, gdb, valgrind.
method_ja: test/recipes/80-test_tsa.t (CAtsa.cnf) に従い TSA を構築し ESS v1/v2 の正規応答を作成、Python の DER 再エンコーダで属性値を BOOLEAN/NULL/INTEGER に置換、openssl ts -verify を BASE/BASE-ASAN/PATCHED/PATCHED-ASAN で実行、gdb、valgrind。
regression_en: Genuine v1/v2 responses (-queryfile, -data, token form, patched-generated reply) verify OK on the patched build; wrong request still rejected; valgrind clean.
regression_ja: 正規 v1/v2 応答 (-queryfile、-data、トークン形式、修正版生成の応答) は修正版で OK。誤要求は引き続き拒否。valgrind クリーン。
limitations_en: TSA keys are regenerated on each run; INTEGER control variant never crashed (ASN1_STRING-compatible).
limitations_ja: TSA 鍵は実行ごとに再生成。対照の INTEGER 変種は元々クラッシュしない (ASN1_STRING 互換)。
